relations.subject: William Robertson
relations.evidence: He studied divinity at the University of Edinburgh (1733–41), and was licensed to preach in 1741.

relations.subject: William Robertson
relations.evidence: He received a Doctor of Divinity in 1759.

relations.subject: William Robertson
relations.evidence: Robertson became royal chaplain to George III (1761), principal of the University of Edinburgh (1762)

relations.subject: William Robertson
relations.evidence: The educationalist and writer James Burgh, who founded a dissenting academy on the outskirts of London, was his cousin, describing him as his "much esteemed friend and relation".
